about: Proposed text_blocks.read_aloud overrides for screen and figure blocks: a short spoken description used by narration instead of the block's HTML. Drafted with model help from text_blocks.data.fields and the surrounding prose. Each is pinned to the block's sha256; if the block changes, the override no longer applies. status 'unreviewed' means no person has signed off yet.

overrides.read_aloud: Four boxes, each holding a triangular pile of blue circles: three in the top left, four in the top right, ten in the bottom left, and thirteen in the bottom right.
The top left pile is down to two.
The bottom right pile is down to twelve.
The bottom left pile is down to seven.
The bottom right box now holds a single circle. The piles stand at two, four, seven and one.
Only two circles remain on the board: one in the top right box, and one in the bottom right.
He writes the four numbers in binary, stacked in a grid: zero zero one one, zero one zero zero, one zero one zero, and one one zero one.
The grid again, with the first row now zero zero one zero.
The grid once more, now with the last row changed to one one zero zero.
His watch shows a call request going out to Senator Verdow.
